title: UI and info mods arrive
body: Scoreboard, Chat, Titles, Boss Bar, Tab Editor, Nick Hider and eight more join the NovoMC Client. 56 mods in total, all toggleable in the Mod Library.

title: PvP visuals and the NovoMC menu
body: 1.7 animations, Hit Color, Block Outline, Motion Blur, Freelook and more, plus a brand-new in-game main menu.

title: One-click Forge for 1.8.9
body: Pick Forge when creating a 1.8.9 instance; NovoMC installs it on first Play and verifies every library.

title: Smoother frames out of the box
body: Every launch now uses tuned garbage-collector flags for fewer lag spikes. Turn them off in Settings if you need to.
